candidates.name: Tryvium
candidates.description: tryvium is an AI-powered, Cloud Contact Center (CCaaS) platform with 106 innovative and advanced features, built on a modern microservices architecture running on Azure. It unifies self-service (AI virtual assistant), copilot-assisted agent support, live human agent engagement, and real-time supervisor analytics — all embedded within Microsoft Teams. tryvium simplifies the Microsoft Teams environment into a full contact center — eliminating the need for complex legacy platforms like Avaya, Genesys, or Amazon Connect for employee support. Not just that, Tryvium transitions the same Microsoft Teams into a full blown CCAAS platform without needing for enterprises an all new CCAAS platform. Most importantly, Tryvium brings 250+ features that a typical CCAAS solution would have but scaling on top of Microsoft Teams integrated within its Unified model. tryvium delivers 4× ROI on existing Microsoft Teams investment. Organizations already invested in Microsoft 365 and Azure can transform their service desk without deploying a separate contact center platform. tryvium eliminates tool-switching, collapses the UCaaS + CCaaS gap, and drives measurable results: 45% ticket deflection via AI self-service, 40% reduction in Average Handle Time, 25% increase in calls per agent, and 30% higher resolution rates.
candidates.rationale: Different category: Tryvium is a CCaaS/contact center platform, while Pylon is shared Slack/Teams customer support for enterprise SaaS.

candidates.name: Capacity
candidates.description: As support costs continue to rise, teams are often overburdened, struggling to maintain service levels while navigating increasing ticket volumes, and facing pressure to find cost-effective solutions to improve performance while managing growing demand. Capacity is an omnichannel support automation platform that helps clients drive down support costs, improve knowledge access, and increase efficiency with practical and generative AI—so your team can do their best work. We offer solutions for intelligent virtual agents, employee enablement and agent assist, and process automation to nearly 20,000 companies worldwide. Today, Capacity automates support over chat, SMS, voice, web, email, helpdesks, and more in one single platform, powered by technology and talent from the acquisitions of Call Criteria, Cereproc, Creovai, Denim Social, Envision, KLaunch, Linc, Lucy, LumenVox, SmartAction, Textel, Verbio and YouCanBookMe. Capacity was founded in 2017 by David Karandish and Chris Sims, and is part of the Equity.com incubator. We’re proudly headquartered in St. Louis. To learn more about Capacity or to request a demo, visit capacity.com.
candidates.rationale: Same broad customer support software category serving similar buyers; Capacity is an enterprise support automation platform like Pylon.

candidates.name: Octocom
candidates.description: Octocom is an AI customer support platform for e-commerce stores, automating customer support for routine tasks and freeing your team to handle only exceptional cases. One-click integration with major e-commerce platforms and help desks, pre-sale and post-sale AI support, and award-winning 24/7/365 live customer support to help brands of any size set up and integrate our AI - all without the exaggerated cost. -AI General Inquiries Say goodbye to generic responses. Our AI excels in understanding and addressing your customers' questions with precision and empathy. Whether it's product details, store policies, or assistance they need, our AI ensures they receive informative and personalized support, anytime. -AI Product recommendations Experience higher conversion rates as your customers find it easier to understand and choose the right products, much like the personal touch of a seasoned salesperson in a traditional brick-and-mortar store. -AI Upselling With a keen eye for opportunities, our AI suggests complementary products or upgrades that align with your customer's interests and past purchases. This not only enhances their shopping experience but also boosts your store's average order value, all without coming off as pushy. -AI Post-sale support The end of a sale is just the beginning of our AI software. From handling refunds and returns to managing orders and tracking shipments, our software covers all post-sale needs. We ensure every transaction ends as smoothly as it begins, leaving your customers satisfied and loyal with the help of an AI. -24/7 Support Our award-winning customer support team is at your service around the clock, every day of the year. Whether you need advice, assistance, or just someone to brainstorm with, we're here to ensure your brand thrives, regardless of its size. With Octocom, exceptional support is always just a message away.
candidates.rationale: Different customer segment and use case: Octocom serves e-commerce support, while Pylon targets enterprise shared Slack/Teams support.

Acesse nosso site e veja como podemos te ajudar:
